card.name: Time spans in treatment duration
card.fires_on: Time units such as months, weeks, year, or monthly after a number, when the text gives how long therapy lasts or how often a check is done. Also a percentage number in trial results.

modes.label: Duration units
modes.description: Months, weeks or year after a number saying how long treatment or follow-up runs.
modes.example: A bone mineral density measurement should be made at the initiation of therapy and repeated after 6 to 12<< months>> of combined FOSAMAX and gluc

modes.label: Monitoring frequency
modes.description: The word monthly or weeks giving how often a test or dose is repeated.
modes.example: Obtain a pregnancy test prior to bosentan treatment,<< monthly>> during treatment and for one month after stopping

card.writes: Suppressed tokens relate to stopping or ceasing, so it seems to lower the chance of stop-related words after a time span.
card.plain: It lights up on the length of time in phrases like 'after 6 months' or 'every 3 weeks'.
